headers.//: Clip and photo filenames are content-derived (md5 of the normalised text, species id), so a file at a given path never changes. Cache it for a year and let the service worker keep its copy. This is what makes ~200 MB of audio cheap to serve.
The update self-heal compares this against the id baked into index.html. Cached, it can never report a new build, and every installed device stays pinned to the old one forever with no error.
The service worker must never be served stale or it cannot ship its own replacement.
The manifest maps text to clip filenames. A stale copy means new content resolves to nothing and falls back to the browser voice.
